mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_flash_sale_reservation WHERE activity_id=#{activityId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_flash_sale_reservation SET quantity=#{quantity}, released_quantity=0, order_id=NULL, order_no=NULL, status='RESERVED', update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RELEASED'
UPDATE dms_flash_sale_reservation SET order_id=#{orderId}, order_no=#{orderNo}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RESERVED'
UPDATE dms_flash_sale_reservation SET status=#{status}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
UPDATE dms_flash_sale_reservation SET released_quantity=quantity, status='RELEASED', update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status!='RELEASED'

UPDATE dms_flash_sale_reservation SET released_quantity=released_quantity+#{quantity}, status=CASE WHEN released_quantity+#{quantity} >= quantity THEN 'REFUNDED' ELSE 'PARTIAL_REFUND' END, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status IN ('PAID','PARTIAL_REFUND') AND released_quantity+#{quantity} <= quantity
